seo.title: PureGamma AI - AI Decisions for Beta, Alpha and Long Gamma
seo.description: AI decision support for individual investors researching market Beta, evidence-backed Alpha, and Long Gamma opportunities.

hero.headline: Decide where to take Beta, where Alpha may exist, Long Gamma NAV 1 > 50.
hero.subheadline: PureGamma AI helps individual investors interpret market direction, verify differentiated opportunities, and evaluate Long Gamma setups with live data, sourced research, and explicit risk context.

research.headline: Three different return questions require three different decision frameworks.

cards.title: Beta Exposure
cards.body: Understand the market regime, direction, volatility, and the risk you are taking with the broader market.

cards.title: Alpha Discovery
cards.body: Look for differentiated information, catalysts, and relative-value evidence that is not explained by market Beta alone.

cards.title: Long Gamma
cards.body: Evaluate convex option exposure using implied volatility, Gamma, Theta cost, liquidity, and event timing.

trust.title: Governance
trust.body: Transparent review materials and suitability boundaries.

trust.title: Verification
trust.body: Source freshness and data lineage are visible before relying on an output.

trust.title: Access
trust.body: Plans, credits, and entitlements control high-cost research workflows.

trust.title: Disclosure
trust.body: Investment limits and research-only boundaries are present across the system.

process.label: Input / Signal Generation
process.detail: Market, portfolio, KOL, and risk data are captured.

process.label: Fusion / Signal Fusion
process.detail: Signals are scored against source freshness and risk.

process.label: Review / Risk Governance
process.detail: Every output is reviewed against disclosure boundaries.

deskItems.title: Market Beta
deskItems.body: Track direction, breadth, funding, volatility, and broad risk exposure.

deskItems.title: Alpha Evidence
deskItems.body: Compare catalysts and independent sources without presenting inference as fact.

deskItems.title: Long Gamma Research
deskItems.body: Screen live Deribit options using IV, Greeks, liquidity, and theta cost.

deskItems.title: Concise Daily Brief
deskItems.body: Turn the evidence into a short decision memo with sources and risks.

accessCards.title: Observe
accessCards.body: Use live market and option data to understand the current decision environment.

accessCards.title: Verify
accessCards.body: Review sources, freshness, assumptions, and conflicting evidence before acting.

accessCards.title: Decide
accessCards.body: Choose exposure with explicit invalidation, cost, and maximum-risk context.
